result.instructions: Tools for ERClinic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments do we have tomorrow, and which are still not confirmed?"; "Find the first free time for a cardiology visit next week with Dr. Silva."; "Who has a birthday this week among our patients?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ERClinic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run erclinic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run erclinic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run erclinic_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. erclinic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: erclinic_list_unities
tools.title: List units
tools.description: List the clinic's units, and whether each accepts in-person and tele-consultation bookings. Good first call. GET /agenda/unities.

tools.name: erclinic_list_specialties
tools.title: List specialties
tools.description: List active specialties (numeric ids), optionally only those of one professional. GET /agenda/specialties.

tools.name: erclinic_list_professionals
tools.title: List professionals
tools.description: List the clinic's professionals (id, name, gender, age range), optionally filtered by insurance, procedure or specialty. GET /agenda/professionals.

insurance_id.description: Insurance id (slug). Needs professional_id in the API; use only with the other filters.

tools.name: erclinic_list_procedures
tools.title: List procedures
tools.description: List active procedures for one professional (id, name, preparation text). Insurance or specialty filters also need professional_id. GET /agenda/procedures.

tools.name: erclinic_list_insurance
tools.title: List insurance plans
tools.description: List active insurance plans (convênios) with their ids, optionally for one professional. GET /agenda/insurance.

tools.name: erclinic_get_available_dates
tools.title: Find dates with free slots
tools.description: List dates with free agenda slots. Defaults: from today to 30 days ahead. Insurance or specialty filters need professional_id. GET /agenda/available-dates.

tools.name: erclinic_get_available_times
tools.title: Find free times on a date
tools.description: List the free times on one date. Insurance or specialty filters need professional_id. GET /agenda/available-times.

annotations.title: Find free times on a date

tools.name: erclinic_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments by date range, appointment id, patient, professional or status (AGENDADO, CANCELADO, CONFIRMADO, ATENDIDO). GET /agenda/appointments/list.

professional_id.description: Only this professional's appointments (sent as profissional_id).

tools.name: erclinic_find_patient
tools.title: Find a patient
tools.description: Find one patient by id, CPF or phone. Returns personal data (sensitive, LGPD). GET /patients.

tools.name: erclinic_list_birthdays
tools.title: List patients with a birthday
tools.description: List patients whose birthday is on one month and day (mm-dd). Returns personal data (sensitive, LGPD). GET /patients/birthday.

tools.name: erclinic_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: Book a new appointment in the clinic agenda. Creates a real booking that patients and staff see. POST /agenda/appointments/.

tools.name: erclinic_confirm_appointment
tools.title: Confirm an appointment
tools.description: Set one appointment's status to CONFIRMADO. Repeating the call leaves it confirmed. POST /agenda/appointments/{agenda_id}/confirm.

tools.name: erclinic_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel an appointment
tools.description: Set one appointment's status to CANCELADO. The slot is freed for other bookings. POST /agenda/appointments/{agenda_id}/cancel.

tools.name: erclinic_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: Register a new patient record in the clinic. Creates personal data (sensitive, LGPD). POST /patients.

tools.name: erclinic_update_patient
tools.title: Update a patient
tools.description: Update a patient's record. The API requires every field, so send the current value for any field you do not change. Personal data (sensitive, LGPD). PUT /patients/{patient_id}.

patient_id.description: Patient id (slug). Sent in the path and as the id query value.

email.description: Email (send the current value if unchanged).

address.description: Street address (send the current value if unchanged).

city.description: City (send the current value if unchanged).

uf.description: State code (send the current value if unchanged).

cep.description: Postal code (send the current value if unchanged).

observation.description: Free-text note (send the current value if unchanged).
